overview: The Handheld LoRaWAN Gateway NLG8140 is a high-performance, portable concentrator designed for precision field testing and industrial IoT deployment.

It is built with the SX1303 next-generation baseband, dual SX1250 radios and the high-power SKY66420 front-end module with an integrated LNA, which together deliver superior sensitivity (−139 dBm at SF12) and up to +27 dBm transmit power. It receives on 8 channels with multi-packet capability in the IN865 band.

A Raspberry Pi 4 (64-bit quad-core ARM, up to 1 GB LPDDR4) provides edge computing, with Wi-Fi as the backhaul. The gateway is WPC certified and is aimed at field testing, industrial IoT, agriculture and environmental monitoring, smart agriculture and asset tracking.
